entities.summary: Gianfranco Ghirlanda is an Italian Catholic prelate and administrator at the Pontifical Gregorian University, where he has taught since 1975, served as dean of the Faculty of Canon Law from 1995 to 2004, and led as rector from 2004 to 2010. He is a member of the Jesuits. Gianfranco Ghirlanda was a writers & intellectuals from Rome (b. 1942-07-05, Rome). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
